result.requirement: The system shall orchestrate multi-channel notifications (SMS, email, app push) by automatically triggering messages when an Order Request status changes to Ready for Delivery or Assigned to a Delivery Partner.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure customers receive timely, consistent updates across all preferred channels to reduce support inquiries and improve the delivery experience.
functional_behaviour: The system shall detect a status change on an Order Request from 'Packed' to 'Ready for Delivery' and trigger a notification.
The system shall detect a status change on an Order Request from 'Ready for Delivery' to 'Assigned' and trigger a notification.
The system shall retrieve the Customer Profile to determine the primary contact method and preferred notification channel.
The system shall send the notification via the selected channel using the contact details found in the Customer Profile.
The system shall log the notification attempt and the delivery status of the message in a Feedback Record.
The system shall suppress duplicate notifications if a message for the same event has already been sent within a defined cooldown period.
related_information_requirements: Customer contact preferences and primary channel
Current Order Request status and event history
business_rules: A notification must only be triggered once per specific status transition event.
The notification channel must match the primary contact method defined in the Customer Profile.
If the primary contact method is unavailable, the system must attempt the secondary contact method.
Notifications must be sent within a maximum threshold of the status change timestamp.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request status changes to 'Ready for Delivery' and the Customer Profile has a valid phone number
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the status update
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall send an SMS notification to the customer within the defined threshold

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request status changes to 'Assigned' but the Customer Profile has no valid phone number or email
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the notification
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall log a failed delivery in the Feedback Record and notify the Platform Operator
